description: Save 40-70% on AI creative tools this Black Friday. Top deals on Adobe Firefly, Kling AI, ElevenLabs, Topaz Labs & more.
body:
AI tools are powerful, but their monthly costs add up quickly.

If you stack enough subscriptions, you can easily end up paying hundreds every month (that easily adds up to thousands per year).

However, I've got good news for you—this is the best time of the year to save on software subscriptions!

Black Friday is the one time you can dramatically cut those costs and get tools you already use for a fraction of the price.

Here are my 9 favorite deals this year:

1. Adobe Firefly – 50% Off Firefly Pro

Adobe Firefly is Adobe’s AI engine for generating images, graphics, and creative assets directly inside your favorite Adobe apps.

It’s perfect for designers who want high-quality, commercially safe visuals that integrate seamlessly with Photoshop, Illustrator, and Express.

Did you know that Adobe Firefly lets you use not only Adobe’s proprietary AI models but also popular community models like Nano Banana and Flux.

This gives you more flexibility and a much wider creative range when producing artwork.

Right now, you can get 50% off the Firefly Pro plan.

Claim the deal →

2. Kling AI – 50% Off 1-Year Subscription

Kling AI is one of the most advanced video-generation models on the market, known for its cinematic realism and smooth motion.

Creators use it for product videos, ads, music visuals, concept scenes, and even short films without touching a real camera.

It excels at dynamic action scenes and complex physics, making it one of the most exciting tools for creatives.

Their annual plan is now 50% off, making it one of the best deals this year.

Claim the deal →

3. Topaz Labs – 43% Off Topaz Studio

Topaz Labs creates industry-leading AI tools for photo and video enhancement, trusted by photographers and filmmakers worldwide.

It’s used to upscale resolution, remove noise, sharpen details, and rescue old footage with stunning clarity.

I use Topaz Labs mainly for photo enhancements because nothing else compares in quality.

I especially love their web app Bloom because there is genuinely no better AI photo enhancer on the market.

If you care about image quality, Topaz is absolutely worth the money—especially at 43% off.

Claim the deal →

4. ElevenLabs – Starter Plan for $1

ElevenLabs is the leading AI voice-generation tool used by YouTubers, filmmakers, businesses, and creators.

It creates natural-sounding voices, characters, narrations, and dubs in any language.

It’s perfect for content creators who want high-quality voiceovers without hiring voice talent.

The Black Friday deal gives you the Starter plan for only $1, which is insane value.

Claim the deal →

5. Recraft AI – 50% Off Pro Yearly Plan

Recraft AI is an AI design tool that generates vector illustrations, icons, patterns, and consistent branded graphics.

It’s loved by designers because it creates editable vector-style artwork rather than just flat images.

I use it for generating variations when I need quick illustration ideas without spending hours manually drawing.

The Pro yearly plan is 50% off, and that discount alone pays for itself if you use the tool even a few times a month.

Claim the deal →

6. Opus Clip – 50% Off Your First Month

Opus Clip is an AI tool that repurposes long videos into short, viral clips ready for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

It automatically finds the best moments, adds captions, and formats your clips for different platforms.

It’s ideal for content creators who want to post consistently without manually editing every single clip.

You can now get 50% off your first month, which is great if you’re boosting your social presence.

Claim the deal →

7. Semflow – Up to 70% Off

Semflow is an AI-powered SEO assistant that analyzes your website and helps you improve content for ranking.

Marketers use it to audit pages, generate keyword ideas, and optimize metadata with one click.

It’s especially useful if you’re running a blog or publishing content regularly.

This Black Friday, they’re offering up to 70% off their plans.

Claim the deal →

8. Descript – Get 1,000 Free AI Credits

Descript is an AI video and audio editing suite that works like editing a document.

You can edit videos by deleting text, overdub your voice, record screens, and fix audio instantly.

It’s one of the easiest tools for podcasters and YouTubers who don’t want to learn complex editing software.

You get 1,000 free AI credits with the Black Friday promotion.

Claim the deal →

9. Freepik AI– 50% Off

Freepik allows you to use variousAI image-generation tools—very convinient for designers, artists, and marketers.

It can create illustrations, concept art, marketing graphics, and social media visuals in seconds.

It’s fast, easy to use, and surprisingly flexible for rapid creative exploration.

The Black Friday discount gives you 50% off your subscription.

Claim the deal →

Conclusion

Black Friday is the best moment to stock up on creative AI tools because the savings can be massive.

Most of these platforms rarely offer discounts throughout the year, so grabbing 40–70% off can save you hundreds of dollars.

If you’re a designer, creator, filmmaker, or entrepreneur, these deals can dramatically lower your monthly tool stack and free up budget for other parts of your business.

But here’s the funny part.

None of the big LLM companies — ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or Claude — offer any Black Friday deals.

They don’t even discount their plans at all, not during Black Friday and not at any other time of the year.

So if you’re waiting for a discount on your favorite large language model, don’t hold your breath.

Your best savings this season are on the creative tools listed above.

Grab the deals while they last.
